fact: Malawi's National Research Agenda 2023-2030, adopted for the Malawi 2063 first 10-year plan, lists digitisation and data management and artificial intelligence as research priorities for 2023-25, to be carried out by universities, think tanks and the private sector under NCST and NPC.
title: National Research Agenda for the Malawi 2063 first 10-year implementation plan (MIP-1)
publisher: Malawi Government (National Commission for Science and Technology; National Planning Commission)
